data.description:
## Description

**What**: Define and implement the recovery contract for dso-config.conf auto-migration when the migration is interrupted (SIGKILL between mktemp write and mv, disk full mid-write, EROFS surfacing after a partial in-memory translation).
**Why**: S4's flock + atomic mktemp/mv handles the happy-path race. It does not specify a recovery story for partial migrations or hand-rolled recovery by users hitting disk-full or interrupted processes. Without an explicit backup-and-restore contract, users have no documented path back to a working state.
**Scope**:
- IN: Backup file naming convention (e.g., `dso-config.conf.v1.bak` written before the atomic rename); restore command/instructions; behavior detection for half-written tempfiles (cleanup on next run); recovery test where SIGKILL fires between tempfile write and mv; recovery test for disk-full after backup but before tempfile write; documented EROFS persistent fallback (in-memory translation + WARN, no backup attempt).
- OUT: Migrating consumer code (S5); the atomic write itself (S4); pre-commit hook (S7).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, a backup of the v1 file is written before any v2 atomic rename ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, an interrupted migration (SIGKILL between tempfile write and mv) is detectable on next run; orphaned tempfiles are cleaned up; user is warned via [DSO WARN] log ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, restore instructions exist in DETECTION-SCHEMA.md or KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for SIGKILL recovery and disk-full edge cases

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Backup creation must itself be atomic enough that a crash mid-backup is recoverable
- [Maintainability] Document EROFS as the one path where no backup is created (in-memory translation only)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a project owner, a partially-completed auto-migration is recoverable
